title: For grouped tasks, make context menu actions affect all windows
line: With inline grouping in the Task Manager, a window's context menu now has Close All to close every window of its group.
explanation: With "Open groups in popups" off (inline grouping, regular Task Manager), every window of a group has its own button and the group parent is filtered out of TasksModel, so the context menu only acts on the clicked window and there was no way to close the whole group. In popup mode the group button already offers Close All. libtaskmanager gains TasksModel::inlineGroupTasks(), which maps a task back to its group in the grouping proxy and returns the indices of all its windows; the Task Manager context menu uses it to show a Close All item below Close when the task belongs to an inline group of two or more windows.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: add TasksModel::inlineGroupTasks()

When groups are shown inline, the group parent is filtered out of the
model, so a view has no way to find the other windows a task is grouped
with. This adds a helper that returns the indices of the whole group.

BUG: 415647

applets/taskmanager: add Close All for inline groups

With inline grouping every window of a group gets its own button, so
the context menu only offered to close that one window. When the task
is part of an inline group, the menu now also has a Close All item.

BUG: 415647

patches.diff:
From 9b7c2e9d7b7e283d8ab58b1dc6b3c29731b48560 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 19:23:10 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: add Close All for inline groups

With inline grouping every window of a group gets its own button, so
the context menu only offered to close that one window. When the task
is part of an inline group, the menu now also has a Close All item.

BUG: 415647
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ContextMenu.qml | 15 +++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 15 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ContextMenu.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ContextMenu.qml
index fe837049fc..da972a1e70 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ContextMenu.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ContextMenu.qml
@@ -869,4 +869,19 @@ PlasmaExtras.Menu {
             tasksModel.requestClose(menu.modelIndex);
         }
     }
+
+    PlasmaExtras.MenuItem {
+        readonly property var groupTasks: menu.visualParent ? tasksModel.inlineGroupTasks(menu.modelIndex) : []
+
+        visible: closeWindowItem.visible && groupTasks.length > 1
+
+        enabled: groupTasks.some(task => tasksModel.data(task, TaskManager.AbstractTasksModel.IsClosable))
+
+        text: i18nc("@action:inmenu", "&Close All")
+        icon: "window-close"
+
+        onClicked: {
+            groupTasks.forEach(task => tasksModel.requestClose(task));
+        }
+    }
 }
--
